verifiedParcelResponse.provider: Nairobi Maps (commercial, non-government provider; not an official registry)
verifiedParcelResponse.method: GET anonymous host request; no Authorization header or session cookie used
verifiedParcelResponse.assessment: Fresh no-cookie GET requests show anonymous polygon geometry works at zoom 16, 18 and 19. A one-point identify returns one MultiPolygon but no properties or feature ID. The public app code gates parcel details/popups (including LR number, area and block) to Gold/Platinum/Admin and shows a locked-details message to Public/guest users. No key or paid account was used.

pointIdentifyCheck.method: GET anonymous host request without account/session
pointIdentifyCheck.assessment: The public point identify returns the polygon geometry only; no LR/parcel/survey-plan reference or feature ID.

name: Nairobi

newFindings.source: Nairobi City County, Built Environment and Urban Planning Sector
newFindings.evidence: County Lands Subsector responsibilities include surveying, GIS/mapping, valuation, land administration/property management and registration. No public county parcel feature endpoint was linked or identified in this pass.
Service front end for land services; public page did not expose a reusable anonymous parcel feature API.
Physical-planning services require account registration; not an anonymous parcel-data feed.

newFindings.source: Nairobi Maps public parcel viewer (commercial, non-government)
newFindings.evidence: Fresh anonymous request to the viewer’s viewport endpoint returned 342 MultiPolygon parcel outlines for a small zoom-16 bbox around the WUP point. The API returned empty properties and no feature IDs, so the anonymous route does not expose a stable parcel key. The provider says parcels are compiled from survey records; this has not been independently confirmed as government-source geometry.

newFindings.source: Nairobi Maps public GIS data page
newFindings.evidence: Provider documents parcel cadastre data and field/coverage notes. WFS is a separate route requiring an organisation API key; the anonymous viewport API does not require that key.
Official notice concerns parcel-number conversion and describes map access through Ministry/survey offices and Ministry site; no anonymous feature service identified.

discoveryChecks.method: Public documentation review only; no API key used
discoveryChecks.result: WFS requires an organisation API key and is separate from anonymous viewport geometry.

sourceQuality: Nairobi Maps is a commercial provider, not an official registry, but its public page and live anonymous API both confirm actual parcel-outline geometry delivery. The API key requirement applies to separate WFS access; it does not technically block the anonymous viewport response. Native parcel identity and attribute availability remain absent from the anonymous response.
blocker: Anonymous polygon geometry is available at zooms 16–19, but the public viewport and point-identify responses contain no native ID or attributes. The viewer’s app gates parcel/plan details to Gold/Platinum/Admin; no paid or organisation key route was used.
remainingUncertainty: Provider says outlines are compiled from survey records, but their source lineage/authority was not independently verified. Anonymous geometry cannot be joined reliably to a registry without a stable ID.
nextStep: Use the published anonymous endpoint only for geometry-only display with provider provenance. For parcel/plan joins, wait for a government-published service or another public endpoint that returns stable IDs without paid/authenticated access.

requests.assessment: Public map page explains parcel outlines are visible without sign-up at zoom 16+; outlines are free to view, while details and WFS access are separate.
Public app script uses viewport GET `api/get_parcels.php?bbox=…&zoom=…` with same-origin credentials; direct anonymous no-cookie GET independently returned 342 outline polygons.
Anonymous geometry works technically; this response does not supply native IDs or attributes.
Provider states WFS returns GML/GeoJSON and requires an organisation API key. This restriction applies to WFS access, not the anonymous visual/viewport outline endpoint.
One 0.001° viewport at higher zoom; anonymous outlines only.
Same small viewport at zoom 19; no native ID or attributes were added.
One anonymous per-point identify returned geometry but no native parcel or plan reference.
